title: The Waiting Room
author: Alexandre Dias
excerpt: The appointment card had no name on it. Only an address, a floor, a time. Ingrid had, at fifty-two, no idea what the appointment was for. She had, all the same, gone. On the third floor of 14 Ullevålsveien was a room. In the room were twenty people. None of them had, so far as they knew, ever been called in.
